title: Compute RCWA transmittance spectra for two grating designs
action: Using an RCWA solver, compute the normal-incidence power transmittance of two GaP grating designs over 0.5–5 THz with frequency spacing ≤0.1 THz. Design 1: pyramidal-frustum with period Λ=15 μm, height h=75 μm, base angle θ=86.5°. Design 2: simple pyramid with same Λ and h but θ=84.3°. Use a constant GaP refractive index n=3.34. Write the results to a CSV.
description: Transmittance spectra for the optimized pyramidal-frustum grating and a simple pyramid grating, used to verify broadband antireflection performance.
output_schema: Columns: frequency_THz (float, units THz), transmittance_frustum (float, power transmittance for the frustum grating), transmittance_pyramid (float, power transmittance for the simple pyramid grating). Frequency range 0.5–5 THz with spacing ≤0.1 THz.
